item.title: Netanyahu Meets Witkoff, Kushner in Washington for Iran Talks
item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu met at Blair House in Washington with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. During their meeting, they discussed regional issues, and Witkoff and Kushner provided Netanyahu with updates on their first round of talks with Iran held last Friday in Oman.

item.title: Thune Warns Democrats Against DHS Shutdown, Urges Deal to Protect Federal Workers
item.description: Leader Thune as DHS shutdown threat looms: “These federal employees at TSA and other agencies shouldn’t be held hostage by the Democrats in potentially another government shutdown. So the best way to avoid that is to strike a deal.”

item.title: Antisemitism in Paris: Jewish Boy Brutally Assaulted On Way To Shul
